q1_what_did_you_play: I spent 3 Sparks with Bag of Tricks to place three Bombs on Seapunk, then played Kaboom! on Seapunk, causing the Bombs to detonate and restore 3 Sparks. I spent those Sparks on Firework Finale targeting Seapunk, then played Spirited Away for 12 Block.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered taking Bag of Tricks' single-Bomb option, then playing Kaboom!, Firework Finale, and Spirited Away. That preserved more Spark but dealt 10 less damage.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the Spark that the single-Bomb line would have retained at turn end, in exchange for 10 additional Bomb damage.
q4_different_intent: Yes. Against a non-attacking intent, I would omit Spirited Away because its Block would not answer the telegraphed action.
